items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: he introduced us to Jack Leer and Jack Leer became our personal manager

ctx.x: She heard about us and Jack Robbins was trying to make a Spanish or Latin catalogue because he had in mind that

this is going to be something big so he got together with Mario, by accident, and he introduced us to Jack Leer and Jack Leer became our personal manager and he got us a few things. So then one day we worked - Diosa Costelo recommend us to Lopez, the owner of the Chateau Madrid, "There was a band in the barrio, tremendous", blah, blah, blah, but Lopez was hesitant about us because he didn't know us.

So we worked one day out there, two days, the off-day of the one day and the other band. So we got there and killed everybody. That was a típica thing. They was playing by ear, practically, "Perfidia" and "Ojos Negros", you know, na na na na na.
